def set_vcpu(self, value):
    """
    Sets the value of vcpu tag in VM XML definition
    """
    xmltreefile = self.dict_get('xml')
    vcpu = xmltreefile.find('vcpu')
    #FIXME: if vcpu == None, then add new vcpu element & data
    vcpu.text = str(value)
    xmltreefile.write()
